verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no settlement or reconciliation report that ties payouts to bank deposits or itemizes fees, refunds, and chargebacks. Related items cover adjacent features only: settlement into the multi-currency wallet, issuing refunds, dispute handling, and AgentOS agents that build cashflow reports. None of these is the itemized reconciliation capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can reconcile settlements to bank deposits with itemized reports covering fees, refunds, and chargebacks
